message: Last week, we had a surprise blackout, and I quickly grabbed my trusty flashlight and power bank. As we sat in the living room, phones lit up and the family group chat exploded with funny memes and updates about who was doing what to cope. It turned into a cozy night filled with laughter, and I realized how important it is to keep our devices charged and stay connected, even when the lights go out. What’s your go-to way to keep the family entertained during a power outage? 😊
